name: io.github.shray77/vetmcp
title: VetMCP
description: Veterinary medicine and epidemiology for AI agents: livestock heat stress (THI/THIadj, 49 stations), 48 h forecast, probabilistic 7-day fan from two ECMWF ensembles (IFS + AIFS), avian influenza risk windows, world bioterror watch, animal disease outbreak surveillance in Russia 2005-today (WAHIS+FSVPS), veterinary science digest, drug reference (ChEMBL properties + Boltz-2 affinities). 10 tools in Russian.
